description: Weapon arts (WeaponArts.gd): weapon families, which arts each unlocks at which family proficiency level, and class signature arts.

fields.name: families
fields.help: family -> {name, items: [weapon ids]}. Uses of every item add up to the family's proficiency.

fields.name: unlock
fields.help: Family proficiency level for: signature (class art), first and second generic art.

fields.name: arts
fields.help: family -> [first art, second art] (skill names, category ART, weapon_family set).

fields.name: signatures
fields.help: class -> {family: skill}. One per class; the Myrmidon (weapon master) has one per family.

fields.name: npc_levels
fields.help: Generated adventurers get arts for what they hold at these levels.
